title: I Followed the Clinic Sign-In Clipboard After They Skipped My Name

parts.text: I signed the clipboard at 1:02 p.m. for a 1:15 slot. At 1:40 they called a man who arrived at 1:28. I was forty-two, holding a referral. I asked to see the clipboard. My name was there, third. They said they go by arrival they notice. I photographed the order, the clock, and my referral time. The nurse manager rewound the list. I went next. The man waited like I had. Noticing is not a queue. Clipboards are. I sat on the table paper at 1:44 and got the blood draw I came for. The list learned eyes. I do not need an argument. I need the third line to mean third. Paper still works when people look.

social.video_title: Third on the clipboard is not a vibe — Part 1/1
social.description: 1:02 sign-in, 1:28 called first, photo of the order. Have you been skipped by noticing?
